{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
filtered_sales = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
completed_orders = filtered_sales[filtered_sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_customers = completed_orders[completed_orders['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders from loyal customers
mean_revenue_loyal = loyal_customers['revenue'].mean()

# Print the required numbers with full precision to ensure the mean is visible
print(f"Number of QA orders removed: {len(sales) - len(filtered_sales)}")
print(f"Number of completed orders after removing QA: {len(completed_orders)}")
print(f"Number of loyal customer completed orders: {len(loyal_customers)}")
print(f"Mean revenue of loyal customer completed orders: {mean_revenue_loyal}")
# Explicitly print the mean with 2 decimal places as the final answer
print(f"Final mean revenue (rounded to 2 decimals): {mean_revenue_loyal:.2f}")"}
